Built **Starlight Sprint**, a playable 3D endless runner in `index.html`. I interpreted the request as a non-explicit game, so the adult runner is fully clothed.

Collect stars, dodge obstacles, and jump through a glowing night garden. It supports keyboard and touch controls with a responsive phone/tablet layout. I verified it in the browser at desktop and mobile sizes; gameplay and the game-over screen both render.

The game uses Three.js from a CDN, so it needs an internet connection to load.
